as_told.title: San Jose woman: inside of disk bigger than outside

plain: Jacques Vallee, a longtime UFO researcher, tells of a woman in San Jose, California, who saw a big disc over her house. On his show, the podcast host Jesse Michels retells Vallee's case and adds that when she went inside the disc, she suddenly found herself in what seemed like a movie theater, much bigger inside than out. If true, it would suggest these craft do not obey ordinary rules of space.
